verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents several public APIs that let an agent read from and act on the product programmatically. The Query API returns the same calculated results as the web app's reports, including events, profiles, activity streams and cohorts. The docs also cover the Raw Event Export and Engage APIs, a Feature Flags API, JQL custom queries, GDPR deletion and retrieval APIs, and a hosted MCP server that can create dashboards. Missing for 10: evidence of write/management APIs beyond feature flags and MCP (e.g. event ingestion or project configuration), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at the standard paths), and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
